name: 1PhoneMirror
description: 1PhoneMirror is a Windows-based screen-mirroring receiver designed for Intune admins to capture consistent, framed mobile-device screens for documentation and training. It supports iOS/macOS AirPlay with optional PIN, Android wireless debugging via bundled adb/scrcpy, and experimental Miracast, delivering one-click screenshots or MP4/GIF recordings inside a device frame. Multiple devices can stay paired and be switched from a bottom bezel, with no app installations on phones.
author: Simon Skotheimsvik

securityCheck.aiSummary: Overall assessment: The codebase is a legitimate build/packaging utility for Intune distribution. It does not exhibit credential theft, data exfiltration, or malicious runtime behavior. However, it relies on external tooling (NuGet/WiX via dotnet, GitHub for vcpkg) at build time, which introduces supply-chain risk. Recommendations: pin dependencies to known-good versions, verify integrity (hashes), consider internal artifact registries or signed tooling, and ensure signing credentials are protected and not logged.
